WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province,
         SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS transaction_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
  JOIN Accounts AS a
    ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  JOIN Customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         transaction_total,
         transaction_total / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_total) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM customer_totals
),
averaged AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         transaction_total,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(transaction_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: State totals with no recorded transaction amounts remain in the state groups as NULL totals, consistent with SUM ignoring missing amounts; groups with no non-NULL amounts therefore have NULL shares and do not qualify.
